```lean
theorem lg_target {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω) [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (A : Set Ω) (hA : MeasurableSet A) : μ Aᶜ = 1 - μ A := by
  have h : μ (A ∪ Aᶜ) = μ A + μ Aᶜ := by
    rw [MeasureTheory.measurableSet_compl hA]
    rw [MeasureTheory.union_compl_eq_univ]
    exact MeasureTheory.measure_union_disjoint (MeasureTheory.measurableSet_compl hA) hA
  rw [MeasureTheory.univ_eq_top]
  rw [MeasureTheory.measure_top]
  rw [h]
  rw [MeasureTheory.measure_top]
  rw [h]
  ring_nf
```
